name: @get-keel/opencode-plugin
description: Keel enforcement plugin for OpenCode — rules that survive context rot

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npx esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:node:* --alias:yaml=../../node_modules/yaml/browser/index.js --outfile=dist/index.js && cp dist/index.js ../../packages/cli/templates/keel-enforce.js && cp src/index.d.ts dist/index.d.ts
